notes.title: PIXELS. The Last Journey
notes.content:
Dear Players,

I want to let you know that in one month, the PIXELS server will be shut down, and the project will come to an end, one year and three months after its release. Fewer and fewer people are logging into the game, and the server costs are no longer sustainable. Since the game became free-to-play, it has stopped generating revenue.

PIXELS has been a small but valuable experience for me in game development. I am deeply grateful to each of you — the players who created stories, competed, shared feedback, and supported the game throughout this journey. Especially to those few individuals who helped during the beta testing phase, participated after the release, and still occasionally log in to play!

As a farewell gift, I’ve made a small adjustment: for the remaining month, the pixel and super-pixel timers will be reduced to just 1 second.

When the servers are shut down, the current state of the canvas will be saved and uploaded into a client version of the game in a “read-only” format. This way, you can influence the final masterpiece that will forever remain in PIXELS!

With gratitude,
The PIXELS Team, represented by Alexander Gromyko

notes.title: PIXELS ARE NOW FREE!
notes.content:
Dear players, the game is now free for everyone! Everyone who supported the game by purchasing it before July 12 received special reward badges as a thank you. 

Invite your friends, join teams and create pixel masterpieces!

notes.title: PIXELS Goes Free on July 12th!
notes.content:
We are excited to announce that starting July 12th, PIXELS will be available for free! Now everyone can dive into the world of creativity, creating unique masterpieces on a huge canvas and sharing them with the community. Join us and discover the limitless possibilities of pixel battle!

[b]All players who purchase the game before July 12 will receive a reward badge![/b].

notes.title: PIXELS 1.1.1 COUNTRIES EVENT
notes.content: Show the world in any way you can (within the law) what country you are from and why it's cool. Respect other participants!

notes.title: HALLOWEEN UPDATE
notes.content:
[b]SCARY FUN!!![/b]

Welcome to the first PIXELS event - [b]Halloween[/b]! Show the world the scariest story on canvas. Could it be Shrek the Pumpkin? Or the Serbian Lady? But not SCP-2006...

Participate in the event, add your drawings in the "EVENT" section and rate the works of other participants. The authors of the most popular works will [b]receive an award[/b] at the end of the event! *You can add only one work.

In addition, the ability to create teams for everyone is open in the game!

Good luck and have fun!

[url=https://discord.gg/bSa2fAPuHv]Join our discord server![/url]
